Life at ODU

Life at Old Dominion University is vibrant and engaging, offering a mix of academic rigor and social activities. Students enjoy a diverse community, with numerous clubs and organizations that cater to various interests.

Faces of ODU

It’s just a matter of using my experience as a blueprint to apply it to local initiatives and natural systems. Right now, I’m just ready to get my foot in the door, wherever it takes me.
Nichole Leach 2026 Biological Sciences
Read Nichole's Story
I want to be able to tell students, ‘I was in the same situation.’ … I want to be the teacher I needed when I was in school.
Adyn Moehring 2026 Special Education
Read Adyn's story
You don’t always know what you don’t know. But I trust my training and the lessons I’ve learned through ROTC.
Katherine Proffitt 2026 Army ROTC
Trying One Class Led to an Unplanned Army Career
If you want to be involved, you have to make the effort. Once I come for the day, I stay for the day, because then I can be involved.
Finley Stoops 2026 Business Administration
Read Finley's Story

Research Powerhouse

Virginia’s most affordable R1 research institution, where groundbreaking discovery meets real-world impact. ODU leverages strong partnerships with military, maritime, government, and industry leaders to advance research in coastal resilience, health innovation, national security, and emerging technologies.

meta.description: Old Dominion University, located in Norfolk, is Virginia's forward-focused public doctoral research institution with approximately 23,500 students, rigorous academics, an energetic residential community and initiatives that contribute $2.6 billion annually to Virginia's economy.

Uh-oh! Looks Like We’ve Roamed Off Course

It seems the page you’re looking for has strayed from the pride. But don’t worry, at Old Dominion University, we’re all about discovery and new adventures. Let’s get you back on track!

Here are some helpful links to guide you:

  • Home – Start your journey here
  • Admissions – Begin your Monarch adventure
  • Academics – Discover our programs
  • Campus Life – Explore student life at ODU
  • University Libraries – Find books, study spaces & labs 
  • Directory – Find Faculty & Staff
  • myODU Portal – Access ODU online resources

Remember, with Big Blue and the heart of a lion, no obstacle is too big. Keep exploring, and you’ll find your way!

Roaring with you,

Big Blue
